Long ago, when the Alpha Blazen was still a little Bolty, it would always stay here with its mother.
Back then, it did not believe lightning was an answer, so it could never evolve into Blazen.
On the day its mother left, it came to the Blitz Tree and desperately hoped the sky would answer.
Then, it evolved into Blazen.
Late at night, when all was quiet, it would come beneath the Blitz Tree and call out with all its heart, but no answer ever came.
Still, it chose to believe. So it kept guarding the Blitz Tree, guarding not only the wishes of other Bolty, but also its own hope.
Until one day, a meteor crossed the sky, and an Egg fell beneath the Blitz Tree. It was as if an answer from the sky had finally arrived.
